# `silk/system/executable`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Resolves a program name against the process search path without starting it.

Import as `Executable` with `import silk.system.executable as Executable`.

Public declarations: 2.

<a id="findBytes"></a>

## `findBytes`

```silk
pub effect fn findBytes(written: &[u8]) -> Option<Path> ! HostInputError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut HostInput | &mut Allocator | &mut FileSystem
```

Resolves a program spelled as host bytes. A path names the program directly; a name searches
`PATH`, with an additional `.exe` candidate on Windows. Missing programs return `None`.

<a id="find"></a>

## `find`

```silk
pub effect fn find(written: string) -> Option<Path> ! HostInputError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut HostInput | &mut Allocator | &mut FileSystem
```

Resolves a program name or path without starting it. Relative paths use the working directory.
